name: BIG-Bench Extra Hard
intro: BIG-Bench Extra Hard（BBEH）用 23 个更难的对应任务替换 BBH 的 23 个任务，在保持推理能力覆盖的同时缓解饱和。完整版含 4,520 个样本，Mini 版含 460 个样本；构建过程中持续修订任务，直到两个参考模型在每个任务上都低于 70%。
build_method: BBH能力映射、23个更难对应任务、双参考模型低于70%的半对抗难度校准
metric: Per-Task Accuracy, Adjusted Harmonic Mean; Mini Micro Average
eval_feature: 固定逐步推理与最终答案后缀、确定性解析和清洗、完整版调和平均、Mini微平均
scale: 完整版4,520题（23个任务；多数每任务200题，Disambiguation QA为120题）；Mini版460题
build_method_en: BBH capability mapping, 23 harder counterparts, semi-adversarial calibration below 70% on two reference models
eval_feature_en: Fixed step-by-step and final-answer suffix, deterministic parsing and cleaning, adjusted harmonic mean for Full, micro average for Mini
intro_en: BIG-Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) replaces BBH's 23 tasks with 23 harder counterparts while preserving broad reasoning-skill coverage. The full set contains 4,520 examples and Mini contains 460; task authors iteratively revise or replace candidates until both reference models score below 70% on every task.
scale_en: Full: 4,520 examples across 23 tasks (usually 200 per task; Disambiguation QA has 120); Mini: 460 examples
metric_en: Per-Task Accuracy, Adjusted Harmonic Mean; Mini Micro Average

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.19187v2 and google-deepmind/bbeh commit 80d12ca. BBEH preserves 23 broad BBH reasoning domains while replacing every task with a harder counterpart. Candidates are semi-adversarially revised or replaced until Gemini 1.5 Flash and Gemini Thinking both score below 70%. The full set has 4,520 examples: normally 200 per task, with 120 for Disambiguation QA. BBEH Mini has 460 examples, 20 per task. Evaluation appends a fixed step-by-step/final-answer suffix, deterministically extracts and minimally cleans answers, reports the full benchmark using the adjusted harmonic mean over per-task accuracies, and reports Mini using micro average.
